newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues 1996 net profit 650 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues 1996 net profit 650 mln Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - Construction company Bouygues gave its results in a statement. A company spokeswoman told Reuters the 1996 net dividend was expected to be unchanged from 1995's 17 francs per share. The company said in a statement that 1996 and the 1997 outlook were marked by a decline in French construction activity, but this was offset by a strong rise in sales in the services sector. Capital gains on asset sales also helped offset lower sales. Group sales for 1997 should hit 83 billion francs, up two percent, once sales of Bouygues Telecom are consolidated.

Excluding Bouygues Telecom, but including Saur and Cise, turnover should be 82.4 billion. Shareholders capital totalled 10 billion francs at the end of 1996, of which seven billion at the net attributable level. This compares with respectively 9.4 billion and 6.3 billion a year ago. Financial debt was 6.5 billion versus 6.2 billion. Its cash holdings were 7.8 billion versus 7.2 billion.
